title: Spells

# Spells

**Spells** are the magical formulae used by the spellcasting classes. The SRD 5.2 catalogs hundreds of spells across **8 schools of magic** and **9 levels of power** (plus cantrips at level 0).

## School of Magic

- **Abjuration** — protective magic and banishment.
- **Conjuration** — summoning and creation.
- **Divination** — information-gathering magic.
- **Enchantment** — mind-affecting magic.
- **Evocation** — raw elemental damage.
- **Illusion** — deception and disguise.
- **Necromancy** — death, life force, and the undead.
- **Transmutation** — alteration of properties and shapes.

## Spell Level

- **Cantrips** (level 0) — minor spells cast at will.
- **1st–9th level** — spells that consume a spell slot of the matching level.

## Spell Tags

The SRD 5.2 introduces the concept of **spell tags** — short metadata attached to each spell (e.g. *Damage Fire*, *Control*, *Detection*, *Healing*) — to help players find spells that fit a situation.

Use the **Spells** page of this application to filter by class, level, school, or concentration/ritual status, and view the full description of any spell.
